items.title: Steve Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 15, 2017
items.q: 1992, my first December week with J Mac officially in the band. I was 24 years old still. We’re playing The Vanguard.

ctx.x: That’s what J Mac called it. And you know, what a lesson right there. I mean it’s December so we used to play, this is 25 years ago, 1992, my first December week with J Mac officially in the band. I was 24 years old still. We’re playing The Vanguard. We’re playing all that hard new music you know, great exciting, everyone’s there. And I look back and I see the silhouettes back by the globe back there. It hasn’t changed at all. And I see, man is that Ronnie Mathews? Is that John Hicks? Is that Larry Willis? All…
He took it back. I just love that.

items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Steve Davis once, “Hey Jackie, come on.” So I go on up there and play with them.

ctx.x: Would you ever consider recording your drumming?

Yeah. The kids up at the school like me to play with them sometime. They don’t have a drummer. Steve Davis once, “Hey Jackie, come on.” So I go on up there and play with them. I – that’s my other instrument that I love, the drums.
How about piano? Where are you with piano?
